title: PALA — A moment at the desk

beats.title: Quiet breathing
beats.intent: Stay gently alive, then pause at rest for a snapshot.

beats.title: Oh, someone is here
beats.human: You roll your chair into view and start working.
beats.intent: Small orienting movement; no wave or celebration.

beats.title: Hello!
beats.human: You turn your head toward the lamp.
beats.intent: Lift, open, and make one broad coordinated wave.

beats.title: You too!
beats.human: You give the lamp a thumbs-up.
beats.intent: Two compact bounces with alternating tilt; finish cleanly.

beats.title: Follow left
beats.human: Point to the lamp's left; release the hand between cues.
beats.intent: Turn in the indicated direction, then return to the visitor.

beats.title: Follow right
beats.human: Point to the lamp's right; release the hand between cues.
beats.intent: Turn in the indicated direction, then return to the visitor.

beats.title: Back to your work
beats.human: You turn back toward your desk.
beats.intent: Wait before disengaging, then soften and return to rest.

beats.title: Occasional breathing sway
beats.intent: Stay gently alive, then pause at rest for a snapshot.
